title: Design: Edit Customer's + tooltip and menu look as designed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Scenario: In a customer's Edit Customer window, you compare the + tooltip and menu with the design pictures.
  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Three active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A}, {Sales-rep-B} and {Sales-rep-C}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able, {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able and {Sales-rep-C} is ZZAUTOTEST Cara Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide with the zoom at 100%, and the design pictures "customer-06-n2-add-tip.png" (board 2.6) and "customer-07-n2-add-menu.png" (board 2.7) attached to this case are open beside it at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • Starting screen: {Customer-A}'s Edit Customer window is open in that browser window.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Hover over the + and compare with the picture of board 2.6.
  2. Click the + and compare with the picture of board 2.7.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the tooltip "Add representative", as in the picture.
  • Step 2: the menu lists "Sales Representative - Service Parts" then "Sales Representative - Part Sales", as in the picture.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S4-R5: “The + button of S2-R1 to S2-R3 sits to the right of the first field, with the tooltip "Add representative".”
  • S4-R6: “Its menu lists, in this order, each field not yet added: "Sales Representative - Service Parts" and "Sales Representative - Part Sales". When both are added the + is not shown.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), export read 19 Oct 2026, boards 2.6 Hover the +; 2.7 The + menu: two options (the attached pictures are these boards).

Design pictures attached to this case: customer-06-n2-add-tip.png, customer-07-n2-add-menu.png.

  • Design — board 2.6 title: “2.6 Hover the +”
  • Design — board 2.6 note: “Tooltip: "Add representative".”
  • Design — board 2.7 title: “2.7 The + menu: two options”
  • Design — board 2.7 note: “"Sales Representative - Service Parts" and "Sales Representative - Part Sales".”
